definitions.optimized_full_range_executable: A selected source-scale implementation exists end to end. A literal but multi-year fallback or disconnected optimized components do not satisfy this gate.
definitions.complete_source_artifact: A data-only artifact contains every semantic input needed by a total Lean checker whose ordinary soundness theorem reaches the exact source claim. A digest-only manifest, one sample block, or an always-rejecting candidate does not satisfy this gate.
definitions.independent_checker: The source-scale route has a fresh replay or checker path distinct from trusting the producer's success flag. Same-library replay is recorded as independent execution, not implementation diversity.
definitions.lean_parser: Lean parses the complete source artifact fail closed, including truncation and suffix rejection.
definitions.lean_total_checker: A total Lean Boolean checks the complete parsed source artifact.
definitions.lean_soundness: Ordinary Lean proves accepted complete artifact bytes imply the exact source claim without an analytic realization placeholder.
definitions.execution_refinement_or_single_trusted_c: The campaign has either ordinary executable/ISA/compiler refinement or the closed registered-invocation route through the project's sole trusted-compute axiom. This gate alone does not assert a run, receipt, or source claim.
definitions.confidential_azure_path: Source-closed confidential Azure materialization exists. This means packageable, not appraised or run.
definitions.target_sku_budget_gate: A source-scale target-SKU measurement supports a high wall-time endpoint below 168 hours and a high cost endpoint below USD 10000. Planning projections and transferred measurements do not count.
definitions.production_receipt: A successfully appraised production receipt is source-admitted in the trusted-compute registry with reviewed deployment pins.
definitions.claude_math_production_integration: The exact production receipt is installed through the conditional source bridge into claude_math. A theorem conditional on a hypothetical certificate does not satisfy this gate.

summary.authoritative_conclusion: No named external campaign is production-complete. All ten are Azure-packageable and registered behind the one explicit trusted-compute axiom, but no target-SKU measurement or production receipt exists. CDEM Abel is the sole complete Lean source-artifact program.
